caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger: "Activates when attacked 10 time(s)" is an INCOMING-hit counter (boss attacks on the squad), not an owner hit/shot counter. v1 models no boss damage, so the real cadence is unobservable in-sim; modeled as hitCount:10 (owner rounds) as a stand-in cadence. UNMEASURED — the Damage Taken ▲ uptime this produces is a guess, not a reading.

⚑ skill1 target: "1 enemy unit(s) with the highest final Max HP" = the sole boss at scope lock; modeled as {kind:'enemy'}. The paired ATK ▼ 9.09% is a boss-offense debuff with no sim consumer (boss ATK is unmodeled) — recorded in unmodeled, not as a block.

⚑ skill2 target split: the kit line covers "self and 2 ally unit(s) with the highest final ATK". alliesTopAtk has no self-inclusive form, so it is authored as TWO blocks (alliesTopAtk count:2 excludeSelf:true + self). If the game instead ranks self INTO the top-2 pool (i.e. self may occupy one of the two slots), this over-covers by one ally. Kit says "self AND 2 ally", which reads as exclude-then-take-2 — the encoding follows the literal wording.

⚑ skill2 "highest final ATK" is a FINAL-ATK ranking per the literal-word rule, but byFinalAtk is NOT set here: the buff is DEF only and offensively inert, so live-vs-static ranking moves zero damage. Set byFinalAtk:true if a future consumer makes the target set matter.
defPct is inert in v1 (self DEF does not affect own damage). All three DEF lines are kept for kit completeness / future consumers, per the do-not-skip-DEF rule.

⚑ burst conditional-damage buff: "Burst Skill damage of skills with 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s)' in the description ▲ 38.91%" is a SCOPED buff on a per-ally kit-text predicate. The schema has no StatKey for 'burst-skill damage of single-target-flagged skills' — attackDamagePct/atkPct would be an unscoped over-credit across the entire team's whole damage. Left unmodeled rather than fudged. Recipe: add a scoped StatKey (e.g. burstSingleTargetDamagePct) gated on a per-override boolean marking which units' burst blocks carry an 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s)' clause, then A/B the carriers.

⚑ burst trigger identity: modeled as burstCast (this unit is Burst I; the line sits in her OWN burst block with no 'entering Full Burst' clause). Burst-cast damage/auras land pre-Full-Burst, so the DEF aura carries no FB major — correct for a stat buff.
⚑ cadence tuple (ammo 6 / reloadFrames 142 / chargeFrames 60 / RL) is datamined and known-unreliable; unverified for this unit.
"Equally shares damage taken" is a survivability redistribution with no v1 consumer (the boss deals no modeled damage and nobody dies at scope lock) — recorded verbatim in unmodeled.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Jackal (RL/Iron/Defender/Burst I) is a defensive/utility kit: her only team-damage-relevant live line is the S1 Damage Taken ▲ 9.09% boss debuff (10 s), keyed to an incoming-hit counter the v1 sim cannot observe — its uptime is a stand-in cadence, not a measurement. The burst's headline 38.91% is a SCOPED buff on allies' single-target burst skills with no matching StatKey; it is deliberately unmodeled rather than approximated by an unscoped damage stat, which would over-credit the whole team. Three DEF grants (S2 8.27%/120 s to self + top-2-ATK allies, burst 14.69%/10 s to all allies) are modeled for kit completeness and are inert in v1. Damage-shared / ATK▼ lines have no v1 consumer.

flags.estimate: hitCount:10 (owner rounds) as a stand-in for "attacked 10 time(s)"
flags.reasoning: The kit counter is INCOMING attacks (boss hits on the squad), an axis v1 does not simulate at all — the boss deals no modeled damage, so the true trigger never fires. Any encoding is an invented cadence. hitCount:10 keeps the debuff live at a plausible-but-arbitrary rate; the honest alternative (drop the block) would silently delete a real team-damage buff. Uptime of the Damage Taken ▲ is therefore UNMEASURED and the single largest source of error in this baseline.
flags.recipe: Record a scope-lock fight with jackal and read boss-attack cadence from the footage (count incoming attack animations to the 10th), then convert to a wall-clock interval and re-key the block to {kind:'interval', sec:<measured>}; cross-check by A/B-ing total team damage with the block on vs off against the recorded total.

flags.estimate: damageTakenPct 9.09 at whatever duty cycle the stand-in trigger produces
flags.reasoning: The magnitude 9.09% is kit-literal (not flagged); the UPTIME is not. A 10 s window on an unknown re-trigger period can range from ~0% to 100% coverage of the 180 s fight, and this is the only line in the kit that moves team damage.
flags.recipe: Same measurement as the trigger flag; then pin with a spec test asserting the number of damageTakenPct buffApply events (casterIdx===null/targetIdx===null boss-held filter by stat+value 9.09) over a 180 s run.

flags.estimate: 38.91% additive on ally burst-skill damage, but ONLY for skills whose text says "Affects 1 enemy unit(s)"
flags.reasoning: No StatKey in types.ts scopes to burst-slot damage filtered by a per-ally kit-text predicate. Encoding it as attackDamagePct would apply to every ally's every hit for 15 s — a large unscoped over-credit (failure mode 1). Leaving it out under-credits single-target-burst carriers instead; that is the conservative, non-fabricating choice per MEASURED > FUDGE.
flags.recipe: Add StatKey 'burstSingleTargetDamagePct' consumed only in the burst bucket, plus a per-override boolean (e.g. singleTargetBurst:true) on carriers whose burst text contains 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s)'; audit the roster for carriers, then A/B a jackal + single-target-burst-carry comp against a recorded fight to confirm the buff lands additively in the Damage Up bucket rather than as its own multiplier.

flags.field: skill2 target split (two blocks vs one)
flags.estimate: self + top-2 OTHER allies by ATK (exclude-then-take-2)
flags.reasoning: Kit says "self and 2 ally unit(s)", which reads as self PLUS two others = 3 covered units. If the game instead ranks self into the same pool, coverage is 3 only when self is outside the top 2, else 2. Damage-neutral today (defPct is inert), but the target set would matter the moment a consumer reads it.
flags.recipe: Zero-cost to leave as-is while defPct is inert. If a consumer lands, confirm from an in-game buff-icon read on a comp where jackal has the highest ATK of the three candidates — count how many allies show the DEF icon.

flags.reasoning: The line sits in this unit's OWN burst block with no "entering Full Burst" / "during Full Burst" clause, so per the trigger-identity rule it fires when SHE casts. As a Burst I unit she casts on essentially every rotation, so burstCast vs fullBurstEnter barely diverges here — but the faithful encoding is burstCast, and it also correctly places the aura pre-FB.
flags.recipe: Structural read of the kit text; no measurement needed unless a comp is built where the FB chain completes without her cast.

Her own normal-attack output is not a load-bearing part of this override (no damage riders), so the error is contained to her personal damage column and burst-gauge generation.
